Internal helper function for getting the breaks and labels for the x axis

Source: R/helpers_plot.R
get_x_scale.Rd

Internal helper function for getting the breaks and labels for the x axis

Usage

get_x_scale(time_selection, x_axis)

Arguments

time_selection

[character(1)]

Determining if the time on the x-axis should be study dates (calendar based) or study days (subject based) Either TIMETYPE_BUTTONS_OPT1 or TIMETYPE_BUTTONS_OPT2.

x_axis

[list]

A list returned by get_x_axis(). Composed of:

  • breaks [numeric(1+)]

    A numeric vector setting the values at which ticks on this axis appear. Only contained in the list if the time selection was "By study day".

  • ticktext [numeric(1+)]

    A character vector setting the text displayed at the ticks position via "breaks". Only contained in the list if the time selection was "By study day".

  • breaks [Date(1+)]

    Vector of the dates where the ticks should be in the plot. Only contained in the list if the time selection was "By study date".

  • title [character(1)]

    Not used in this function.

Value

a ggplot2 scale object used to configure the x-axis.

  • [ggplot2::ScaleContinuousPosition]when time selection is "By study day" (numeric axis).

  • [ggplot2::ScaleDatePosition] when time_selection is "By study date" (date axis). This object can then be added to a ggplot to define tick positions and labels for the x-axis.
